jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Studio Team
jobs.description:
Great products come from people who refuse to compromise on quality.

We believe everyone has a story worth sharing, and anyone can become an exceptional video creator with unlimited reach. Our mission is to build top-quality tools for video content creators.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Studio, our core product. This role requires strong UX intuition, visual taste, and full ownership. You’ll work in a small team, taking features from idea to production.



What you’ll do

 - Guide product direction, define requirements, and ensure high-quality delivery

 - Find simple, elegant solutions to complex product problems

 - Work directly with the founding team

 - Explore and prototype ideas using Figma, v0, Cursor, Claude Code

 - Contribute code directly to production with full dev access

 - Ship fast, learn, iterate

 - Get user insights to validate ideas and iterate based on feedback

 - Set metrics, track performance, and use data to make better decisions

 - Collaborate with design and engineering to build the product, and with support, marketing, and sales to launch


What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years of Product management or product design experience in a SaaS company

 - Proven track record in building, releasing, and scaling global consumer products

 - Passion for design and attention to small details

 - Ability to move fast, shift focus, and adapt in dynamic environment

 - Highly collaborative and results oriented

 - Bonus: experience in streaming, video, creator tools, or a design background




Back in 2015, Restream http://restream.io was founded in Ukraine with a passion for helping creators be seen and heard. As the #1 multistreaming solution, we deliver over 200,000 hours of live content every day. We’re diverse team across 15 countries and 22 nationalities — building tools that power the future of live video. We believe that a small, driven, and focused team can impact millions of lives.


What We Offer

 - A startup environment and a flat company structure

 - Work closely with founders and team to build and grow the product

 - Opportunity to make an impact on the evolution of the product

 - Ability to create something that influences people’s lives

 - Equity packages for you to truly be a part of the Restream journey

 - The hardware and software you need to get your job done


Takeaways

 - Great products come from people who refuse to compromise on quality

 - You'll work directly with the founding team to design core features and experiences (Cursor)

 - We execute on interaction and visual details with a high degree of polish, focusing on shipping, learning, and continuous improvement

 - Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, resource-constrained startup environment

 - You can move fast – prototyping ideas in hours, not days
